name: audiobook-creator
description: Turns a document's text into a real, chaptered .m4b audiobook using local, offline neural TTS (Kokoro-82M) — no cloud API, no per-use cost, no text ever leaving the machine. Two modes: Plain narration (verbatim, one voice) and Story mode (rewrites dry source material into a themed narrative with narrator/character multi-voice assignment). Output is a single .m4b with FFMETADATA1 chapter markers, so it gets real chapter navigation, resume position, and speed controls in Apple Books, Podcasts, and Overcast. Synthesis runs as a background job with polling, since a book-length document takes minutes. Requires ffmpeg on PATH; the ~120MB Kokoro model downloads once on first use and is cached locally forever after.
